While the reception was negative, the event itself remains a standard interaction within a democratic society.
President Trump attended the NBA Finals at Madison Square Garden, where he was met with audible boos from the crowd while seated in the owner's box with James Dolan.

The Bright Side:
Public figures attending major sporting events demonstrates a commitment to shared cultural spaces, even when the reception is hostile.

This is a Q7 (EFFECT) event. The error lies in assuming elite proximity (WHO) translates to public approval (EFFECT).

The Unavoidable Lie: That elite proximity shields a leader from the reality of their public standing.
